title: Paid tier for an internal tool
summary: Turning an internal analytics tool into a paid product. Expect security and privacy, execution and financial risk to lead; a paid pilot is the usual mitigation.

input.proposition: Launch a paid tier of our internal analytics tool to outside customers within six months
input.background: We have 25 engineers, no billing system, and the tool currently handles only internal data. Two pilot customers have asked for it.
